title: Provider-neutral Codex-style turn adapter

request.turn: one bounded sha256 reference; no payload

invariants: Discovery is local metadata only and does not establish provider availability or authorization.
Every lifecycle result is bound to exactly AR-0015 revision 5, one session/worktree, and this adapter identity.
A turn carries only a digest reference; prompts, transcripts, provider commands, credentials, and raw output are outside the contract.
Unknown fields, capabilities, states, revisions, and post-terminal operations are rejected.
Interruption and failure are terminal observations and cannot be reported as successful completion.

compatibility.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline

privacy.projection: safe identifiers, states, dispositions, bounded codes, and digests only

limitations: The model, checker, and fixtures are offline deterministic state machines; they do not launch Codex, any provider, a process, network, Git, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, or LLM.
Capability discovery is not proof of provider availability, authentication, model behavior, filesystem isolation, or runtime success.
Real provider adapters, supervision, durable persistence, signing, and remote execution remain separate contracts.
